hero.lede: I design websites and web platforms, and I train people in digital — search, marketing, artificial intelligence. I work alone, from Dakar, for the West African market. Whatever you buy here is paid in CFA francs, with Wave, Orange Money or a card.

pistes.lede: One is done for you, the other is done by you. Neither is the waiting room of the other: you can take one and never meet the second.
pistes.conceptionMeta: Shops and small business · Custom projects · Work
pistes.conceptionBody: The track for websites and web platforms, at two levels of engagement: a fixed-price offer for shops and small businesses, and a scoped custom engagement for wider projects. The work already shipped is listed there.
pistes.apprendreMeta: Courses · Blog · Podcast and videos · The Digitos Club
pistes.apprendreBody: You learn to do it yourself: local search, marketing, applied AI. The blog, the podcast and the videos open with no account and nothing to pay.

proof.lede: One fact is recorded here, and it is read in the database the moment this page loads: the date of my latest publication. Nothing about audience, nothing I couldn't reopen in front of you.
proof.truthBody: The count of what I have published — articles, episodes, videos, courses — is read in the database, with its date, on the « I'm Max-Morrys » page. The home page keeps only the date of the latest publication. No followers, no views, no student count anywhere: I have nothing honest to say about them.

latest.empty: Nothing is published here yet. The blog opens first: it reads with no account and nothing to pay.
